front-end.title: Aurora Tecidos
front-end.description:
Shopify Engineering + UI System Design | Proprietary Theme ELOY V2

Overview

Aurora Tecidos was not simply a redesign.
It was a full reconstruction of the brand’s digital experience.

The project began with a strategic UI creation in Figma a prototype developed in approximately 8 hours to quickly validate visual direction, hierarchy, and usability. The client was facing clear issues: cluttered layout, poor readability, and navigation friction.

The objective was to transform the store into a modern, clear, and highly functional environment for an audience that is not accustomed to complex interfaces.

The UI was designed as a system.
The theme was engineered as infrastructure.

Context & Problem

Aurora’s audience primarily values clarity and practicality. Small typography, excessive information, and competing visual elements were directly affecting the shopping experience.

The challenge wasn’t simply to “make it look better.”
It was to make the journey intuitive, predictable, and comfortable.

We needed to:

  • Reduce visual noise

  • Establish strong information hierarchy

  • Improve readability

  • Reinforce trust signals

  • Maintain a frictionless purchase flow

UI Strategy (Design System)

The strategy was to structure the store as a coherent visual system with replicable patterns.

1. Homepage as a Strategic Showcase

The homepage was designed to function as a digital showroom:

  • High-impact slideshow

  • Informational cards with objective icons

  • Structured product grids (Best Sellers, New Arrivals, You May Also Like)

  • Integrated social proof

  • Physical location block (map integration) to reinforce real-world presence

Each section follows a predictable visual rhythm, enhancing scanability and reducing cognitive effort.

2. Product Page Oriented Toward Decision-Making

The product page was intentionally simplified.

Absolute priority was given to:

  • Product title

  • Enlarged price typography

  • Installment visibility

  • Clear primary CTA

Secondary information (shipping calculator, additional details, etc.) was structured inside collapsible menus and controlled sections to avoid cognitive overload.

The focus was reducing friction and accelerating decision-making.

3. Functional Header & Footer

  • Direct category navigation

  • Clear iconography

  • Organized institutional information

  • Clean and objective structure

Nothing ornamental. Everything functional.

Execution Fidelity

The implementation achieved approximately 98% fidelity to the approved Figma prototype, preserving:

  • Typographic scale

  • Spacing system

  • Visual hierarchy

  • Brand color palette

The UI was treated as a system — not as a suggestion.

Theme Engineering

ELOY V2 – Reengineered Dawn-Based Architecture

The UI was only the surface.

To support this experience, I used my proprietary theme ELOY, originally built on Shopify’s Dawn. For Aurora, the theme evolved into a fully restructured and optimized V2.

This was not a simple update.
It was a technical reengineering.

Technical Stack

  • Modular Liquid architecture with advanced variant logic

  • Custom JavaScript interactions

  • SEO-optimized semantic HTML

  • Refined CSS3 with full responsive control

Key Improvements in V2

🔍 High-Resolution Zoom System

  • Maximum definition image viewing

  • Smooth modal interaction

  • Performance preserved

🖼 Image Optimization

  • Intelligent compression

  • Progressive loading

  • Improved Core Web Vitals impact

🎨 Smart Variant System for Fabrics

  • Visual swatches with real thumbnails

  • Multi-pattern compatibility

  • Intuitive size selection (50cm / 1m logic)

🚚 Frenet API Shipping Integration

  • Real-time shipping calculation

  • Clean, non-invasive UI integration

🛒 Slide Cart System

  • No full-page redirects

  • Instant updates

  • Dynamic free-shipping incentive messaging

📍 Integrated Location Map

  • Reinforced physical presence

  • Increased credibility and trust

Performance & Stability

ELOY V2 was engineered for:

  • Higher performance scoring

  • Scalable architecture

  • Reduced dependency on third-party scripts

  • Long-term stability for future expansion

Result

Aurora Tecidos gained more than a new layout.

It gained:

  • A coherent visual system

  • A robust technical architecture

  • A simplified user experience

  • A scalable foundation for growth

UI and Engineering worked as one unified system.

The result is a Shopify store that combines clarity, performance, and structural stability built to grow without sacrificing user experience.

front-end.title: Portfólio
front-end.description:
Personal Portfolio | Author project + front-end built from scratch | HTML, CSS and JavaScript

Overview

My personal portfolio is an author project created to represent my visual identity and professional journey as a front-end developer with precision. The concept goes beyond showcasing work, it was designed as a personal brand experience, with a modern, creative, and professional aesthetic based on an orange and gray palette.

Context and objective

The development spanned about 11 months, balancing my Systems Analysis and Development studies with real freelance deliveries. The objective was to build a showcase that communicates technical maturity, visual consistency, and execution capability, delivering a smooth and engaging navigation experience from start to finish.

The challenge

The main challenge was balancing strong visual personality with clarity and performance, without relying on frameworks. It was necessary to maintain rhythm, readability, and responsiveness across every section, while supporting a dynamic experience with animations and interactions without sacrificing lightness, code organization, or aesthetic consistency.

The strategy

Structure the portfolio as a navigation narrative, where each section reinforces a stage of my professional identity. Color alternation and content hierarchy were planned to create visual rhythm and guide the user naturally, keeping reading predictable and attention focused on the most important points.

What was implemented

Front-end built from scratch:

  • HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript: full structure without frameworks to keep total control over performance, responsiveness, and visual customization.

  • Visual standardization: consistent typography, sizing, spacing, and contrast definitions to maintain readability and cohesion.

  • Rhythm-based navigation: color alternation between sections to create a more engaging scrolling experience.

Interactions and dynamic experience:

  • Dynamic loading and behavior: implementation of flows that make the experience more responsive and alive.

  • Animations and microinteractions: visual effects designed to reinforce modern feel without compromising performance.

  • Modals and action buttons: modal triggers, CTA interactions, and responsive behaviors integrated into the layout.

AI support and complementary structure:

  • OpenAI Codex: using the agent to generate the back-end foundation based on technical prompts written with precision.

  • Front-end integration and logic: implementing the necessary connections to ensure integrated and consistent functionality.

Result

The result is a portfolio that works both as a showcase and as a product, communicating identity, consistency, and technical execution. It represents what I can build today and how I continuously evolve, as a living project that is constantly refined, following my professional journey and drive to innovate.

front-end.title: Loja da RO
front-end.description:
Loja da RO | Author project | Shopify + Liquid + HTML, CSS, JavaScript and JSON

Overview

Loja da RO was born as a personal project with a meaningful purpose: creating an online store as a tribute to my mother. More than a technical exercise, it was designed to translate emotion into visual identity, building a digital experience with presence, delicacy, and intention.

Context and objective

In March 2023, I started the development on Shopify with the goal of going beyond what free themes usually allow. Over three months, I deepened my knowledge of Liquid and the Shopify ecosystem structure, studying the documentation and applying HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON to evolve the theme and customize the experience with more freedom.

The challenge

The main challenge was overcoming free-theme limitations without losing consistency and visual quality. It was necessary to redesign the interface for a female audience, keep navigation intuitive, and at the same time create custom components that elevate the user experience and reinforce brand identity with a professional finish.

The strategy

The strategy was to start from a standard Shopify theme and rebuild the experience through a full visual redesign, creating a modern and delicate visual system. The pink-toned palette, rounded corners, and soft elements were designed to strengthen emotional connection with the concept, while structural adjustments ensured clarity, usability, and visual rhythm throughout the navigation.

What was implemented

Visual redesign and identity:

  • Redesigned interface: rounded corners, soft graphic elements, and a lighter composition to reinforce a feminine and welcoming aesthetic.

  • Pink color palette: selection and standardization of colors to strengthen brand presence and keep consistency across pages.

  • Author details: vectors and visual choices designed to represent my mother’s unique characteristics within the store’s universe.

Technical customization in Shopify:

  • Liquid as the customization foundation: study and practical application to adapt sections, components, and theme behavior.

  • HTML and CSS: structural adjustments and visual refinement to elevate finishing and layout consistency.

  • JavaScript and JSON: behaviors and configurations implemented to increase flexibility, improve experience, and overcome limitations of the base theme.

Components and user experience:

  • Custom contact forms: contact flow built with its own structure and styling to improve usability.

  • Custom footer: tailored footer creation to organize information and improve end-of-journey navigation.

  • UX consistency: careful attention to page flow and visual rhythm to keep the experience smooth and intuitive.

Result

The final result exceeded my personal expectations and officially marked the beginning of my career as a front-end developer. Beyond the visual delivery, the project consolidated practical mastery of Shopify and Liquid, strong redesign and theme customization skills, and technical execution with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON, all grounded in an author concept with real meaning.

front-end.title: Adega Paradiso
front-end.description:
Adega Paradiso | Shopify e-commerce | Figma UI implementation + Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and JSON

Overview

Adega Paradiso was an important milestone in my freelance journey, as my second professional project. The client brought a bold Figma layout, featuring ticket-style cards, which increased complexity and made the project a strong execution challenge.

Context and objective

The objective was to translate the Figma design into a Shopify store with maximum fidelity, preserving identity, hierarchy, and visual polish. The experience needed to perform equally well on desktop and mobile, delivering a sophisticated, scan-friendly, and commercially effective storefront for a wine catalog.

The challenge

The core challenge was implementing a layout that initially seemed difficult to reproduce inside Shopify, especially due to the ticket-style cards and the need to maintain consistency across sections. In addition, the product page had to be information-rich without feeling heavy, organizing technical wine details in a visual, easy-to-consume format.

The strategy

The strategy was to treat the UI as a system and implement each component with precision, ensuring the Figma visual standard remained consistent throughout the journey. In parallel, the product page was structured to transform technical wine information into scan-friendly content, using icons and metafields as visual support, increasing perceived quality and supporting purchase decisions.

What was implemented

High-fidelity Figma implementation:

  • Ticket-style cards: component built with custom structure and CSS, preserving the look and finish of the original layout.

  • Full responsiveness: grids and sections adapted to maintain readability and visual consistency on desktop and mobile.

  • Hierarchy and consistency: standardized spacing, typography, and colors to sustain a sophisticated look across the store.

Rich and scan-friendly product page:

  • Detailed metafields: structured data such as origin, profile, and aging potential to enrich product content.

  • Illustrative icons: iconography applied to transform technical information into fast, readable insights and reinforce perceived value.

  • Well-distributed content: blocks organized so the page stays informative without feeling overloaded.

Applied technical stack:

  • Liquid and JSON: theme customization and configuration of sections and data to support the UI and metafields.

  • HTML and CSS: component development and visual refinement with attention to detail.

  • JavaScript: interaction and behavior adjustments to keep the experience dynamic and smooth.

Professional delivery and validation:

  • Workana project: negotiation and delivery with professional alignment, ensuring a complex proposal was executed with quality.

Result

The result was a visually sophisticated and consistent online store, with an optimized experience for desktop and mobile. The product page became a key differentiator, turning wine information into a clear and premium presentation through metafields and iconography. Adega Paradiso further consolidated my skills in front-end execution, high-fidelity UI implementation, and advanced Shopify customization.

front-end.title: Mundosado
front-end.description:
Shopify e-commerce | Premium branding + Figma UI + custom theme (Dawn) | BDSM marketplace and sexyshop

Overview

MundoSado was born from a strategic conversation with the client, who envisioned a high-end brand for the BDSM universe. The goal was to build an e-commerce experience with strong identity and a straightforward purchase flow, occupying a space where competitors still did not deliver a premium level of presentation.

Context and objective

The goal was not simply to list products online, but to build a brand with presence, clarity, and consistent visual standards, able to compete on perceived quality. Shopify was chosen as an operational and scaling decision, while the visual project and theme engineering would ensure differentiation, trust, and a smooth buying experience.

The challenge

This segment requires balancing visual impact and objectivity, because the journey must be fast, discreet, and trustworthy. We needed to translate references from the Brazilian sexyshop landscape into something unique without feeling generic, keeping strict standards for spacing, margins, and readability. In addition, the implementation had to move beyond a “default theme” into a truly customizable theme, with logic, components, and content that supported a premium positioning, reinforcing privacy, discreet delivery, and purchase security.

The strategy

Build a premium storefront with clean, direct navigation, prioritizing hierarchy, scannability, and consistency across every page. The process started in Figma with competitor research and idea synthesis, turning references into a proprietary visual system. Next, the strategy was to convert that system into a highly editable theme, reinforcing trust elements through clear, repeatable communication, including the use of objective, standardized icons as a continuous visual language across the site.

What was implemented

Art direction and Figma UI:

  • Research and references: analysis of competitors in Brazil’s sexyshop market to map storefront patterns, credibility cues, and user journeys.

  • Layout and visual system: creation of a clean, direct layout with consistent spacing, margins, and hierarchy to support faster decision-making.

  • Conversion-oriented storefront: design of sections to highlight best sellers, new arrivals, and recommendations, keeping fast readability and product focus.

Theme development and front-end engineering:

  • Theme foundation: using Dawn as a base due to its robust structure and sections, serving as a starting point for a V1 theme and continuous evolution.

  • HTML and CSS: structural changes to faithfully reproduce the Figma layout, refining composition, grids, spacing, and visual consistency.

  • JavaScript: rewriting and adding scripts to improve interactions and component behavior, ensuring a smoother experience.

  • Liquid and conditional logic: creating and refining rules to make the theme flexible, supporting different catalog and page scenarios.

Experience, trust, and visual consistency:

  • Standardized, objective icons: implementation of a recurring icon system for benefits and security, improving scannability and reinforcing trust at key points in the journey.

  • Privacy communication: strategic emphasis on messages such as discreet delivery, packaging against curiosity, neutral sender, and discreet invoice, reducing friction and increasing user comfort.

  • Structured product page: organization of content into clear blocks, including description, instructions, and technical specifications, improving readability and purchase decisions.

  • Consistent identity: strong application of a dark palette with red accents, creating premium presence and guiding attention to actions and key information.

Organic SEO and technical content:

  • SEO structure: organization of meta descriptions and essential elements to improve search-engine interpretation.

  • Image optimization: standardization and improvement of related attributes and text, focusing on keywords and discoverability.

  • Foundation for evolution: planning the theme to support continuous performance and metrics improvements in future versions.

Result

The project reached a stable V1 theme in about 45 days and was launched after alignment with the client, delivering a premium storefront with strong identity and a direct purchase journey. The experience became more trustworthy and comfortable, with clear privacy messaging and a standardized icon system that reinforces benefits throughout the site. In 2026, the project was paused due to the client’s personal reasons, which prevented ongoing optimization and metric improvements, but the foundation remains solid and ready to evolve.

front-end.title: Wee Magazine
front-end.description:
The Wee Magazine project consisted of a complex platform migration, moving the entire online store from VTEX to Shopify. With prior experience in platform migrations, my responsibility was to recreate the store theme from scratch, ensuring visual fidelity to the original layout and optimizing crucial aspects such as performance and SEO.

The new theme features interactive menus organized with subcategories and strategic product highlights, providing intuitive navigation. Among the implemented functionalities is real-time shipping calculation directly on the product page, using an intermediary API integrated with Frenet that I developed. Additionally, the project included an efficient responsive design, ensuring an excellent browsing experience on both mobile and desktop devices.

Other important improvements include a footer structured into distinct sections organizing institutional information and security seals, as well as an exclusive WhatsApp purchase button that facilitates direct contact between customers and support.

This project reinforced my ability to transform technical challenges into innovative solutions that are always aligned with the store’s visual identity and strategic objectives, demonstrating advanced skills in Shopify, integration with external APIs and search engine optimization.

front-end.title: Snugfly
front-end.description:
SnugFly was a monthly ongoing development project on the Shopify platform. It began with performance-focused optimizations and evolved into a complete theme redesign, culminating in the creation of an entirely new theme that was later discontinued by the client. Throughout this process, I implemented several visual enhancements to the store’s layout, introducing rounded graphic elements and vector illustrations, such as small stylized airplanes, which provided a lighter and more engaging visual aesthetic.

I leveraged HTML, CSS and JavaScript extensively, along with advanced programming logic, to customize and adapt the store for integration with various US-based plugins, creating tailored solutions that ensured seamless harmony across all features.

Although some visual decisions were guided by the client’s personal preferences, the SnugFly project was a significant opportunity to showcase my technical creativity and further refine my skills in web development, plugin integration, and advanced Shopify customization.

front-end.title: CervejaBox
front-end.description:
The CervejaBox project involved migrating a beer club subscription page from the VTEX platform to Shopify. The main challenge was maintaining the page’s flexibility, allowing the client to easily edit the beer combinations offered each month without compromising performance or usability.

The entire page layout was fully rebuilt using HTML and CSS. The combination logic was developed with JavaScript, ensuring that users could customize their orders easily and without any errors or technical limitations. Issues previously encountered on the VTEX platform were resolved in this new implementation, resulting in a more stable, efficient, and intuitive page for subscribers.

This project reinforced my technical skills in front-end development, platform integration, troubleshooting, and advanced Shopify customization, while significantly improving the overall user experience on the CervejaBox site.

front-end.title: Blend
front-end.description:
Blend Comunicação was a project developed in partnership with my business partner, for which we created a complete visual identity intended for a future agency. Although currently on hold, we built an “idle”-style landing page that serves as a visual showcase for the brand.

The page features the Blend Comunicação logo centered on screen, accompanied by an animated gradient background that blends colors in a fluid and sophisticated manner. Using only pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, we crafted a modern and immersive visual experience that dynamically highlights the brand’s colors and elements, delivering a unique and engaging impact. This project underscores my expertise in front-end development, visual design, and implementing interactive web animations.

front-end.title: GLRifas
front-end.description:
The GLRifas project aimed to create a LinkTree-style landing page to centralize the main entry points for a business specializing in online raffle sales. I developed a modern interface that emphasizes a glassmorphism design on the main card, showcasing the GLRifas icon and brand in a sophisticated way.

The chosen color palette combines black and gray, complemented by a vibrant yellow on the primary button that directs users to the Discord server (the platform used for raffles and draws). I also added social media buttons to maintain a clean, clear and focused layout.

For this page’s development, I used HTML, JavaScript and Tailwind CSS to ensure a responsive structure, agile styling and easy future maintenance. The final result is a visually impactful and highly functional landing page perfectly aligned with GLRifas’s young, dynamic identity, demonstrating my expertise in modern design, responsive front-end development and integration of current technologies.

ui-design.title: UI Aurora Tecidos
ui-design.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Figma UI + Theme Implementation | Fabrics and haberdashery

Overview

Aurora Tecidos was a Shopify project created to elevate the visual experience and simplify the purchasing journey for an audience that is not used to complex interfaces. The project began with a Figma prototype developed in approximately 8 hours, designed to quickly present the new visual direction and align expectations with the client.

Context and objective

The client was facing visual layout issues in the existing Shopify store and needed a more direct, modern, and clean experience. The objective was to simplify navigation, increase readability, and create consistency by reinforcing the brand’s primary colors and standardizing typography, font sizes, and information hierarchy for fast reading and frictionless purchasing.

The challenge

The main challenge was designing an accessible experience for customers who can easily feel overwhelmed by small fonts, excessive information, and competing visual elements. It was necessary to reduce noise, maintain focus on what truly matters, and at the same time preserve trust and credibility with supporting elements such as installment details and secure purchase indicators.

The strategy

The strategy focused on building a scan-friendly journey with clear and predictable content blocks. On the homepage, the store was structured as a decision-oriented showcase, with sections that repeat visual patterns to make comparison easier. On the product page, the approach was to prioritize only essential information, leaving secondary details accessible through collapsible areas or action buttons, without overcrowding the first visible section.

What was implemented

Homepage designed as a showcase:

  • Slideshow and main highlight: primary section focused on visual impact and immediate readability.

  • Informational cards: objective blocks highlighting free shipping thresholds, customer support, installment options, and secure purchasing to reinforce trust without overloading the layout.

  • Strategic product showcases: organization of products into “Best Sellers,” “New Arrivals,” and “You May Also Like” for cross-sell and extended browsing.

  • Social proof and physical presence: section with real customer reviews and a “where to find us” area prepared for map integration, reinforcing the store’s physical location.

Product page focused on essentials:

  • Clear hierarchy: title and price highlighted with larger typography to improve visibility and reduce cognitive effort.

  • Secondary information via interaction: installment details and shipping calculation treated as supportive elements, accessible through buttons and expandable sections without competing with the primary CTA.

  • Organized content: description and reviews structured in clean blocks, maintaining visual consistency and pleasant readability.

Header and footer with objective navigation:

  • Direct menus: categories displayed clearly so customers can quickly find what they are looking for, reducing navigation friction.

  • Icons and support text: visual reinforcement for key functions and institutional information, maintaining a clean and functional standard.

UI fidelity:

  • Prototype-aligned implementation: the final UI achieved approximately 98 percent fidelity to the approved Figma design, preserving typography, spacing, and color standards.

Result

The result was a more modern, clean, and user-friendly Shopify store, focused on readability and fast decision-making. The homepage became a structured showcase with strong commercial sections and social proof, while the product page prioritizes essential information and reduces visual noise, maintaining clarity and trust from entry to checkout.

ui-design.title: UI Mundosado
ui-design.description:
Shopify e-commerce | Figma UI + Illustrator icons + custom theme (Dawn) | BDSM marketplace and sexyshop

Overview

MundoSado was born from a strategic conversation with the client, who envisioned a high-end brand for the BDSM universe. The goal was to build a premium and discreet experience, with direct navigation and mature visual communication, elevating trust in a segment where privacy is part of the purchase.

Context and objective

The goal was not simply to launch an e-commerce store, but to build a brand with presence and consistent visual standards, capable of delivering comfort and security at every step of the journey. Shopify was chosen for its operational robustness, while the Figma UI defined the layout system, components, and visual rhythm, ensuring a fast, scan-friendly, consistent experience on desktop and mobile.

The challenge

This segment requires balancing impact and discretion, because users must be able to buy quickly, clearly, and without visual noise. We needed a strong storefront that did not feel generic, with strict standards for grid, spacing, and hierarchy, while reinforcing privacy through repeated trust messages placed at the right decision points. Another challenge was standardizing an icon and card language that felt mature and clean, without infantilizing the theme and without losing objectivity.

The strategy

Start with Figma UI to define a consistent layout and component system, then convert that into a highly customizable theme. The strategy was to turn the homepage into a conversion-driven storefront, with benefit blocks and well-organized product sections, and to structure the product page as a complete page with objective blocks for description, instructions, specifications, and reviews. To reinforce discretion and fast reading, I used a custom, standardized icon system with a modern, direct, mature aesthetic.

What was implemented

Figma UI and visual system:

  • Desktop homepage: hero banner with privacy messaging as the main communication axis, followed by benefit cards and product showcases organized by intent, such as best sellers, new arrivals, and recommendations.

  • Desktop product page: a complete layout with gallery, variants, strong CTA, and well-separated content blocks including description, instructions, technical specifications, and reviews.

  • Mobile homepage and product page: responsive adaptation with preserved hierarchy, prioritizing search, CTA, and block-based reading, avoiding tiring scrolling and reducing friction.

  • Grid and spacing: standardized margins, alignment, and breathing room to keep visual consistency and fast readability across sections.

Illustrator icons and discreet visual language:

  • Original iconography: icons illustrated and refined in Illustrator to feel more mature, clean, and modern, reinforcing benefits without cluttering the interface.

  • Standardized trust messages: recurring use of icons and microcopy to reinforce points such as discreet packaging, hidden sender, generic invoice, and secure purchase.

  • Cross-page consistency: strategic repetition of iconography at decision points across homepage and product pages to create recurring trust cues.

Conversion and trust structure:

  • Privacy top bar: a concise privacy message at the top to reduce user anxiety from the very first interaction.

  • Intent-based showcases: clear sections such as best sellers, new products, and “you may also like”, supported by consistent card patterns and action buttons.

  • Objection-handling educational block: a step-by-step section explaining discreet purchasing to reduce friction and increase comfort.

  • Social proof: reviews area and reputation highlight to reinforce security and reduce objections before checkout.

  • Technical content in blocks: separating description, instructions, and technical specs to make content lighter and more scan-friendly.

  • Recommendation and higher ticket: a “people who viewed also bought” section for cross-sell and continued browsing.

Header and mobile experience:

  • Functional header: composition with hamburger menu, centered logo, cart with counter, and prominent search to reduce time-to-product discovery.

  • Search as a priority: a wide search field on mobile to accelerate discovery and reduce clicks in a large catalog.

  • Consistent CTAs: high-contrast buttons and uniform styling to keep actions clearly visible.

Result

MundoSado gained a premium, consistent UI with a direct and discreet experience, reinforcing privacy and security as trust pillars. The custom icon system improved scanability and visual maturity, while the homepage and product structure were organized for conversion, with clear benefits, social proof, and recommendations. The result is an e-commerce experience that looks professional, is comfortable to navigate on desktop and mobile, and is built to sell within the segment’s expectations.

ui-design.title: UI Portfolio
ui-design.description:
UI Prototype | Figma wireframe + visual system | Personal portfolio

Overview

This was the initial prototype of my personal portfolio, created to validate an immersive, non-conventional visual experience before the final development. It went through several iterations during the process, but served as the foundation to define narrative, scroll rhythm, and visual identity.

Context and objective

Before this version, I had already built the wireframe in Figma and then evolved it into a more complete prototype, with well-defined aesthetics and content hierarchy. The goal was to design a clear section-based navigation, making the progression of information obvious across the homepage, about, skills, projects, certifications, and contact.

The challenge

The main challenge was balancing a strong visual personality with fast readability. The layout needed to be memorable without sacrificing scannability, especially on mobile, and it had to support different content types such as project cards, skills blocks, and the certifications area while keeping a unified aesthetic throughout the journey.

The strategy

I designed the prototype around a scroll-based narrative, with clearly defined sections and a predictable hierarchy for the user. The visual strategy was to create a consistent “universe” with reusable components and enough contrast to guide attention, keeping the experience fluid from the top down to the contact section.

What was implemented

Section architecture and flow:

  • Step-by-step navigation: defining a flow that moves through the homepage, about me, projects, skills, certifications, and contact in a sequential and easy-to-understand way.

  • Visual rhythm: clear separation between blocks with breathing room and transitions, preserving a sense of continuity while scrolling.

Component system:

  • Project cards: a standard structure with title, thumbnail, description, and a “view project” CTA, creating repetition and predictability.

  • Skills in grids: reusable blocks to list technologies and level, making comparison and scanning easier.

  • Certifications as cards: organizing certificates with consistent identity, keeping the section clean and objective.

Visual identity and consistency:

  • Palette and contrast: using dark tones with orange accents to create a strong signature and guide attention.

  • World-building graphic elements: composition with illustrated and thematic decorative elements to reinforce memorability without losing organization.

Result

The prototype consolidated the foundation of my portfolio in terms of structure, narrative, and visual identity, serving as a bridge between the wireframe and the final build. It helped validate section hierarchy and the consistency of the component system, preparing the project to evolve with refinements throughout the process.

ui-design.title: Portfólio Wireframe
ui-design.description:
My personal portfolio is a project developed with the aim of fully reflecting my visual and professional identity, using a strategic combination of shades of orange and gray to achieve an impactful and distinctive layout. Each section was carefully planned to convey an image that balances professionalism and creativity, highlighting my unique personality and style.

This project has been under development for approximately 11 months, balancing my academic studies with freelance work. The result is a platform that not only showcases my main projects but also authentically communicates my essence as a professional. The alternation of colors between sections provides visitors with a dynamic and engaging visual experience.

web-designer.title: Mundo Catnip
web-designer.description:
Shopify e-commerce | Custom layout + banners | Pet shop specializing in cats

Context and objective: The store used an old theme with an amateurish look and needed a redesign to convey more professionalism and affection for feline products. The goal was to elevate the visual to something more modern and aligned with the brand manual, without losing the joy and playful identity of the pet segment.

Challenge: The available kitten photos had homemade and little neutral backgrounds, which made compositions difficult. It was necessary to find a visual solution that accommodated these images without breaking the harmony of the layout. Working with strong colors and feline patterns required creativity to avoid visual pollution or mischaracterizing the brand.

Solution and execution: The base of the store was maintained in a pre-existing theme, and from this structure I made a series of improvements in HTML and CSS to adapt every detail to the identity of Mundo Catnip. I created modern banners taking advantage of the patterns, logos and vectors of the brand manual, and used vibrant tones inspired by the love for cats to play with bar sections and newsletter. The customizations ensured that each element reflected the essence of the brand, even within a standard theme.

Result: The result was a modern online store, with an impactful visual and faithful to the affectionate essence of the brand. The interventions in code and the creative use of patterns transformed the site, bringing the experience closer to what Mundo Catnip represents: a universe of products for cats with personality, color and love.

web-designer.title: Farmarela
web-designer.description:
GreatPages landing page | Art direction + conversion design | Farmarela licensing

Overview

Farmarela’s landing page was created for expansion campaigns focused on selling licenses, with the goal of turning traffic into qualified leads consistently. The project focused on building a page with strong institutional presence, high offer clarity, and a premium visual experience that supports trust and contact intent.

Context and objective

The project came from a B2B partnership operation, where there was a need for landing pages ready for acquisition campaigns. After alignment, I was responsible for the full visual creation of the page in GreatPages, ensuring a clear conversion narrative aligned with the licensing model pillars and with an aesthetic consistent with Farmarela’s identity.

The challenge

A high-conversion landing page requires balance between impact and readability, especially for an offer that involves investment, where credibility and clarity matter a lot. The challenge was to create a visually strong page without tiring the user, organize the sections with solid hierarchy, and elevate image quality to maintain a premium standard. In addition, we needed original graphic elements to differentiate the page from generic layouts and reinforce brand presence.

The strategy

Build a section-by-section narrative that guides the user smoothly, combining authority blocks, pillars, social proof, and recurring CTAs. Visually, I used Farmarela’s main colors as highlights and white backgrounds to keep breathing space and visual comfort. The strategy also included improving visual assets with AI and professional finishing, plus adding custom vectors and icons to increase brand perception and consistency.

What was implemented

Visual direction and page composition:

  • LP creation in GreatPages: structuring sections, content hierarchy, and strategic CTA placement to guide the user to the form.

  • Palette and identity: using the brand’s key colors as highlights and light backgrounds to increase readability and reduce visual fatigue.

  • Modern mockups: creating mobile mockups with a contemporary look and depth feel to showcase materials and campaign content.

Images, quality, and premium finishing:

  • AI enhancement: creating and improving images using Gemini with Nano Banana Pro to boost sharpness, lighting, and realism.

  • Professional final retouch: finishing and corrections in Photoshop to ensure consistent color, contrast, and visual polish.

Icons, vectors, and original elements:

  • Vector work in Illustrator: creating and vectorizing sections with drawings and branded graphic elements, raising the overall professional feel.

  • Icons and readability reinforcement: applying icons to improve scannability, separate topics, and reinforce fast understanding of the pillars.

Result

The result was a landing page with strong institutional aesthetics, clean visuals, and a well-guided conversion narrative. The combination of light backgrounds with highlighted brand colors delivered comfort and brand presence, while enhanced images and original vectors elevated the premium perception. The LP was delivered ready for campaigns with a more professional presentation, reinforcing trust and increasing the potential to generate qualified leads.

web-designer.title: Economize
web-designer.description:
GreatPages landing page | Art direction + conversion design | Farmácia Economize licensing

Overview

Farmácia Economize’s landing page was created for expansion campaigns focused on selling licenses within the network’s more premium positioning. The project’s focus was to turn traffic into qualified leads with a page that communicates brand strength, credibility, and offer clarity from the very first sections.

Context and objective

The project came from a B2B partnership operation, where there was a need for landing pages ready for acquisition campaigns and for capturing potential licensing partners. After alignment, I was responsible for the full visual creation of the page in GreatPages, ensuring institutional consistency, a clear conversion narrative, and a look aligned with the premium segment.

The challenge

A licensing LP needs to balance impact and readability, especially when the decision involves investment and comparison with other market options. The challenge was to build a visually strong page without tiring the user, organize sections with clear hierarchy, and sustain credibility with high-quality imagery and graphic elements. It was also necessary to differentiate the LP from generic layouts by using original assets and a modern composition.

The strategy

Structure a section-based narrative that guides the user smoothly, reinforcing the offer, authority, pillars, and social proof with recurring CTAs. Visually, I used Farmácia Economize’s main colors as highlights and white backgrounds to keep breathing room and visual comfort. The strategy also included elevating the premium perception with AI-enhanced imagery, professional finishing, and custom vectors incorporating the brand to reinforce consistency.

What was implemented

Visual direction and page composition:

  • LP creation in GreatPages: section structure, content hierarchy, and strategic CTA placement to guide the user to the form.

  • Palette and identity: applying red and brand elements as highlight points, combined with light backgrounds for readability and visual rhythm.

  • Modern mockups: creating mobile mockups with a contemporary look and depth feel, reinforcing materials and the operation’s digital presence.

Images, quality, and premium finishing:

  • AI enhancement: creating and improving images using Gemini with Nano Banana Pro to boost sharpness, lighting, and realism.

  • Professional final retouch: finishing and corrections in Photoshop to ensure consistent color, contrast, and visual polish.

Icons, vectors, and original elements:

  • Vector work in Illustrator: creating and vectorizing sections with drawings and graphic elements incorporating the brand, increasing perceived professionalism.

  • Icons and readability reinforcement: applying icons to improve scannability, separate topics, and speed up understanding of pillars and benefits.

Result

The result was a landing page with strong institutional aesthetics, clean visuals, and a well-guided conversion narrative. Highlight colors reinforce brand presence without compromising readability, while enhanced images and original vectors elevate premium perception. The LP was delivered campaign-ready with a more professional presentation and stronger potential to generate qualified licensing leads.

web-designer.title: Rede Economize
web-designer.description:
GreatPages landing page | Art direction + conversion design | Rede Economize licensing (two models)

Overview

Rede Economize’s landing page was created for expansion campaigns with an additional strategic goal: presenting the operation’s two licensing models in a clear and convincing way. The project focused on turning traffic into qualified leads, guiding the user to quickly understand the differences between an efficient model and an efficient model with premium positioning.

Context and objective

This is the third LP delivered within the same expansion operation, maintaining visual and narrative consistency across the pages. The key difference in this LP is its comparative role: beyond capturing leads, it needs to help users choose the best model without creating confusion, preserving the network’s institutional strength and keeping both paths as valid options.

The challenge

When there are two offers, the biggest risk is losing conversions due to uncertainty. The challenge was to structure the page to educate users quickly without adding friction, making the differences between models obvious and easy to compare. At the same time, it was essential to maintain premium aesthetics, comfortable readability, strong hierarchy, and visual assets at the same high standard as the other LPs in the operation.

The strategy

Build a section-based narrative that starts with promise and authority, then leads into a clear comparison block between the two models. The strategy relied on consistent visual language, recurring CTAs, and scan-friendly blocks, using color highlights and iconography to guide understanding and decision-making. The design kept light backgrounds for comfort and institutional colors as focus points, reinforcing credibility without tiring the user.

What was implemented

Visual direction and page composition:

  • LP creation in GreatPages: structuring sections, hierarchy, and CTA placement to keep the conversion flow from start to finish.

  • Model comparison section: visual organization to present both licensing formats clearly, highlighting differences without devaluing either option.

  • Palette and identity: applying institutional colors as highlights and light backgrounds to increase readability and maintain visual rhythm.

Images, quality, and premium finishing:

  • AI enhancement: creating and improving images using Gemini with Nano Banana Pro to boost sharpness, lighting, and realism.

  • Professional final retouch: finishing and corrections in Photoshop to ensure consistent color, contrast, and polish.

  • Modern mockups: creating mobile mockups with a contemporary look and depth feel to reinforce materials and digital presence.

Icons, vectors, and readability reinforcement:

  • Vector work in Illustrator: creating and vectorizing sections and graphic elements with brand presence, increasing perceived professionalism.

  • Iconography for comparison: using icons to separate benefits, organize information, and speed up understanding of differences between models.

  • Scan-friendly blocks: structuring content in cards and objective sections to reduce friction and increase retention.

Result

The result was a strong institutional landing page aligned with the other LPs in the operation, with a clear differentiator: the ability to present two licensing models in an objective and persuasive way. The page guides users with more clarity, reduces indecision, and keeps focus on conversion, reinforcing credibility and increasing the potential to generate qualified leads across both investment profiles.

web-designer.title: Capriccio
web-designer.description:
Tray e-commerce | Visual direction + theme configuration | Food and seasonings

Overview

Capriccio already had strong presence in physical retail, appearing on shelves in supermarkets and local grocery stores, but needed to translate that authority into a digital experience that truly drives purchase intent. The project focused on building a strong online storefront with consistent identity and professional visual communication to accelerate the brand’s entry into e-commerce.

Context and objective

The challenge here was not simply “being online”, but looking established from the very first visit. The store had to communicate product-line variety, build trust, highlight bundles and weekly deals, and at the same time convey the feeling of a real brand present in everyday life, just as it already was at the physical point of sale.

The challenge

The greatest responsibility of this project was the visual layer, because in food e-commerce purchase decisions are heavily influenced by imagery, composition, and fast readability of benefits. We needed to create a complete ecosystem of assets, ensuring unity across banners, icons, product grids, and sections without making the site look like a generic template. In addition, part of the imagery needed quality upgrades to keep a premium standard across the entire layout.

The strategy

Turn the homepage into a premium supermarket-style storefront with clear, repeatable communication. The approach was to organize the journey into scan-friendly blocks, reinforcing product lines, weekly offers, bundles, and recommendation sections, always with visual consistency. The goal was to guide the user with clarity and create a strong visual rhythm, reducing noise and increasing trust.

What was implemented

Visual direction and static content:

  • Banners and campaigns: creation of hero banners, category banners, bundle cards, and highlight assets for deals and benefits.

  • Icons and theme elements: development of icons and static images to reinforce credibility, key advantages, and quick scanning.

  • Banner humanization: use of premium stock imagery to bring real-life context of kitchen, family, and everyday routines, elevating brand perception.

Image quality and refinement:

  • Upscale and visual enhancement: using Gemini Pro with Nano Banana to improve quality and finishing of specific images, maintaining consistency in sharpness and lighting.

  • Catalog standardization: careful attention to cropping, proportions, and coherence across images so grids, bundles, and sections do not compete visually.

Theme configuration and structure:

  • Layout and hierarchy: color configuration, section positioning, product-grid organization, and content insertion in strategic areas.

  • Responsiveness: content adjustments to maintain strong readability and impact on both desktop and mobile.

  • Presentation best practices: structuring blocks such as weekly deals, best sellers, bundles, and supporting content to increase time on site and purchase intent.

Result

Capriccio gained a storefront with a strong, cohesive, commercial visual presence, looking professional from the very first fold. The project elevated the brand’s digital positioning with more human banners, well-organized product grids, and consistent visual identity, creating an environment ready to sell and compete with established e-commerce brands.

web-designer.title: Registrando Marca
web-designer.description:
The Registrando Marca project involved the complete redesign of a landing page developed on WordPress using Elementor and Elementor Pro. The primary objective was to modernize the site’s visual appearance, which had previously fallen short in conveying the brand’s desired credibility.

By harmoniously combining the brand’s colors with contemporary design elements, the new layout introduced visual features such as smooth waves, rounded corners, and modern icons, giving the site a sense of lightness and modernity. Additionally, an institutional video and forms with antispam verification were incorporated to ensure that user-submitted data was both complete and protected.

The result was an attractive and functional page that fully met the client’s expectations, standing out for its visual clarity and secure data submission. This project strengthened my expertise in interface design, usability optimization, security, and advanced proficiency in WordPress and Elementor.

web-designer.title: Razzo
web-designer.description:
The Razo project involved creating a landing page on the WordPress platform based on a layout previously provided by the client via Figma. Although the main focus was not on intensive programming, the challenge lay in faithfully reproducing the original design, supplemented by final adjustments to fully meet the client’s expectations.

The result was a modern, responsive site enriched with rounded borders and animated elements, delivering a dynamic and enjoyable experience for users. The page also includes a translation plugin to ensure accessibility for a diverse audience and is structured into three main sections: Home, Services, and Contact.

Razo’s landing page exemplifies how the combination of thoughtful design and precise implementation can produce visually appealing and highly functional results, enhancing both user experience and brand identity.

web-designer.title: Vibe Terapias
web-designer.description:
WordPress landing page | Visual direction + Elementor Pro build | Lead capture for myofascial release therapy

Overview

Vibe Terapias was developed as a lead-capture landing page focused on conversion, designed to turn visits into appointments. The page’s core goal is to position the service as a real solution for pain relief, using strong visual storytelling, social proof, and a clear path to contact.

Context and objective

The client needed a page that communicated authority and differentiation in the therapy space, making it clear that this is not a spa, but a service aimed at pain relief and functional improvement. The objective was to create a visual structure that guides users through pain points, method, differentiators, session flow, and outcomes, with well-placed CTAs and comfortable readability.

The challenge

In health and wellness pages, the biggest challenge is balancing warmth with technical credibility without falling into a generic look. The page needed to sustain a professional positioning with premium aesthetics, organize a large amount of content without exhausting the user, and create visual rhythm with well-defined sections. Another key point was ensuring consistency across images and components, maintaining unity while the page shifts between authority, technical explanations, step-by-step guidance, and social proof.

The strategy

Build a section-by-section narrative with strong hierarchy, combining positioning, benefits, proof, and action-driven guidance. Visually, the strategy was to work with a sophisticated earthy palette and light backgrounds for breathing room, use curved section transitions to create rhythm and guide the eye, and rely on scan-friendly blocks with icons and cards to speed comprehension. The goal was to reduce friction and increase confidence so users continue toward scheduling.

What was implemented

Visual direction and page narrative:

  • Clear hierarchy across sections: a journey that starts with positioning, moves into method explanation, and ends with social proof and FAQ.

  • Visual rhythm with curved sections: alternating blocks and transitions to keep flow and avoid a long, tiring page feel.

  • Recurring CTAs: action buttons placed throughout key sections to capture intent at the right moment.

Structure and build in WordPress:

  • WordPress with Elementor Pro: full build of the visual structure, organizing sections, grids, cards, and components for easier maintenance and iteration.

  • Conversion-oriented sections: blocks dedicated to differentiators, pain assessment, session flow, transformation stories, and frequently asked questions.

Images and premium consistency:

  • Image curation and placement: selecting and positioning images to reinforce the therapeutic proposal, focusing on credibility and warmth.

  • Visual proof of the method: emphasis on elements that communicate technique and differentiation, such as thermal camera assessment and the focus on myofascial release.

Trust elements and social proof:

  • Differentiator blocks: scan-friendly presentation of benefits and authority points in icon-based cards.

  • Transformation stories: a section with videos and reviews to reinforce credibility and reduce objections.

  • Structured FAQ: organized questions to address doubts and support the decision to reach out.

Result

The result was a premium landing page with comfortable readability and a clear narrative, positioning Vibe Terapias as a professional solution for pain relief. The WordPress and Elementor Pro structure delivered flexibility and visual consistency, while the use of images, well-marked sections, and social proof strengthened trust and increased the potential to convert into appointments.

web-designer.title: Apolodog
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout + special landing pages | Products for dogs

Context and objective: The client wanted to create an online store to sell the products they manufacture specifically for dogs. The goal was to bring the love for pets to the digital world with a showcase that conveyed quality and showed their use in the daily lives of the owners.

Challenge: The home page needed to be very visual, filled with images that evoke the coexistence with pets, and the products should have pages rich in details, including videos, photos and technical information. In addition, it was necessary to incorporate exclusive landing pages for kits and special offers, without losing the uniformity of the rest of the store.

Solution and execution: I developed the entire layout implementation in Shopify, creating a modern and responsive design. I worked on customized product pages for kits, with a differentiated structure, and maintained a standard for the other items. I adjusted the theme with extra sections to support videos, photos and longer texts. I used the brand's orange and black tone in several elements, reinforcing the visual identity and the presence of the colors throughout the site.

Result: The result was a modern and well-built layout, which presents realistic photos of everyday life with the products and conveys a sense of trust and quality. Videos, GIFs and usage images reinforce how the items fit into the routine of dog owners, while special landing pages strategically highlight the kits.

web-designer.title: Torelly Joias
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Visual identity + theme setup | Jewelry store with premium positioning

Context and objective: Torelly Joias emerged from the client's direct need: to update the virtual store for a more premium and refined look, aligned with the real product proposal. The goal was to increase perceived value and make the shopping experience more elegant, without losing clarity and trust during navigation.

Challenge: The client sought an aesthetic inspired by strong market references, with the sophisticated touch of brands like Tiffany and Pandora. The challenge was to create this sense of luxury without being a copy, finding a balance between delicacy, presence and own identity. To do this, the visual direction needed a well-thought-out palette, bringing tones inspired by the green waters of the sea as the brand's signature.

Solution and execution: I developed the logo and the entire brand kit, defined the primary color and led the complete layout assembly on Shopify using a third-party theme already adopted by the company. Most of the structure was built without code, prioritizing consistency and speed, but with specific adjustments made in HTML and CSS to refine important details. These refinements helped to reinforce sophistication in the visual finish and keep the store organized for showcases, collections and product highlights.

Result: The result was a store with a more sophisticated presence, combining the intensity of the greenish tones of the sea with an elegant and aligned theme to the premium positioning. The final identity brought personality to the brand and elevated the visual standard of the showcase, preparing the operation for campaigns, collection expansion and a stronger communication of perceived value.

web-designer.title: Agomide
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout | Fashion store with a strong identity

Context and objective: The old store layout was amateurish and had performance issues, harming the shopping experience and brand perception. The client wanted a modern and impactful look that conveyed the strength and presence of her personal positioning.

Challenge: The client already had some banners ready, and the biggest challenge was to create a structure that accommodated them well without losing harmony. To do this, I developed a grid in the “favorite products” section with five banners, balancing the dimensions and maintaining an attractive aesthetic. Another critical point was to ensure that the new layout not only renewed the appearance but also improved website loading and fluidity.

Solution and execution: I implemented a modern and impactful layout on the platform, reinforcing the brand's presence in every element of the home page and sales area. I adjusted the structure to highlight the banner grid and created a homepage that emphasized the catalog and visual identity of the brand. The work included performance adjustments and optimization of existing images to avoid speed loss.

Result: The final layout was impactful and well-organized, reinforcing the idea of a present and strong brand. The grid arrangement of the five banners in the highlight section brought a unique and attractive visual, while the design and performance improvements provided a more fluid and professional browsing experience. The result translates the brand's bold positioning into a consistent digital environment.

web-designer.title: Pratesia
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout | Silver accessories store

Context and objective: The client was already selling silver accessories on social media and wanted to expand sales with a more robust digital presence. The goal was to translate the elegance and shine of silver into an online store layout that was both sophisticated, delicate, and inviting to new customers.

Challenge: The brand's logo has an unconventional shape, which made it difficult to apply it to a white header. It was also necessary to balance several light colors from the original palette to maintain readability and modernity, without sacrificing the refined aspect that a jewelry brand requires.

Solution and execution: I developed the layout on Shopify seeking modernity and sophistication, using rounded borders and a color composition designed to enhance the logo. I adjusted the header to use the brand's main color, creating contrast and highlighting the visual identity. The chosen palette, with silver, navy blue, and white, was applied consistently throughout the store, harmonizing with the products and reinforcing the refined accessory proposal.

Result: The resulting layout was well organized and conveyed a sense of light luxury, with harmony between the shine of silver and the tones of blue and white. The change in the header valued the logo and gave a sophisticated air to the whole, contributing to a purchase experience more consistent with the quality of the products offered.

web-designer.title: Zayah Accessories
web-designer.description:
Shopify e-commerce | Custom layout | Handmade earrings with stones

Context and objective: The project arose at a delicate moment, when the client was already completely dissatisfied with the current store and had no expectations of improvement. The brand sells handmade earrings with stones, full of color and personality, and needed a digital showcase that valued this beauty and restored confidence in online sales.

Challenge: The client realized, in practice, that most purchases occurred from the homepage, because many customers accessed the site and bought directly what was visible there. This transformed the home page into the main showcase of the business and increased the responsibility of the layout, since the organization of the products needed to be clear, attractive and designed for immediate conversion.

Solution and execution: I implemented a new layout in Shopify and reorganized the colors to be more faithful to the logo and the brand's positioning. I structured the home page to function as an open catalog, with a wide and well-distributed grid, prioritizing variety and visual impact. The idea was to reduce distractions and give prominence to the earrings, making the navigation simple and objective to facilitate the purchase decision.

Result: The result was a strong showcase, built to highlight the diversity, beauty and unique colors of the handmade earrings. Instead of relying on carousels, the home page now presents a large and direct grid, with many products exposed immediately. This reinforced the main objective of the store, which is to sell by showing product clearly, abundantly and visually irresistible.

web-designer.title: Garden Joias
web-designer.description:
Nuvemshop e-commerce | Custom layout + banners | Fine jewelry with premium showcase

Context & objective: The client was dissatisfied with the previous visual, which seemed amateurish and did not value the fine jewelry proposal. The objective was to rebuild the store with a more elegant presence, bringing credibility and a finish that matched the product level.

Challenge: The brand's photos were of high quality, so the banners needed to follow this standard to avoid “undermining” the perceived value. The focus was to create sophisticated compositions, with well-adjusted typography and cutouts, maintaining a fine and consistent aesthetic with the showcase.

Solution & execution: I implemented the entire layout on Nuvemshop and created the banners following a more premium line, enhancing the images and organizing the home to function as the main showcase. I worked on visual hierarchy, spacing, and a cleaner composition to give prominence to the pieces, maintaining an elegant rhythm between sections and highlighting products.

Result: The result was a modern and elegant store, with high-quality visual content and an initial showcase that reinforces the feeling of sophistication. The banners were refined and consistent with the photos, creating a stronger and more aligned experience with the fine jewelry positioning.

web-designer.title: Silfer Joias
web-designer.description:
Yampi E-commerce | Custom layout + CSS adjustments | 925 silver with clean aesthetics

Context and objective: Silfer Joias was born from the need to expand sales from social networks to a more structured and scalable environment. The goal was to create a virtual store that conveyed trust and sophistication, valuing the 925 silver pieces with a light and well-organized visual.

Challenge: The project did not have complex execution challenges, but required attention to the limits of the front end on the platform. Some desired visual choices needed direct CSS adjustments to unlock layout details and elevate the finish.

Solution and execution: I implemented the layout on Yampi and made CSS improvements to make the experience more refined and sophisticated, taking care of spacing, hierarchy and a sense of elegance. I worked on the composition with light tones to keep the site clean and intuitive, ensuring that the focus remained on the pieces and navigation.

Result: The result was a store with a fine and practical design, with light tones that harmonize with the brand's gray and the natural shine of the 925 silver. The structure is intuitive and easy to buy, reinforcing the perception of quality and preparing the brand to grow digitally with more consistency.

web-designer.title: Adonai Semi Jewelry
web-designer.description:
Yampi e-commerce | Custom layout + CSS adjustments | Semi-jewelry brand identity in wine

Context and objective: The project arose from the client's desire to build a virtual store for semi-jewelry that faithfully reflected the colors and personality of the brand. The objective was to create a sophisticated and modern digital storefront, with a simple shopping experience and a visual that reinforced perceived value.

Challenge: The main difficulty was the limitations of the front-end on the platform, which required technical solutions to achieve the expected finish. It was necessary to adjust layout details and visual behavior to maintain consistency, readability and brand presence on all pages.

Solution and execution: I implemented the layout on Yampi and made modifications in CSS to circumvent the limitations and elevate the design level. I worked with the palette with wine as the highlight color, balancing with light tones to keep the site clean and elegant. Rounded edges and the organization of sections helped to create a fluid navigation, with a current and well-aligned aesthetic to the semi-jewelry segment.

Result: The result was a modern and sophisticated store, with well-applied predominant colors and a clean layout that values the products. The CSS improvements ensured a more refined finish, reinforcing the brand identity and delivering a digital storefront ready to sell with more presence and professionalism.

web-designer.title: Cantinho Cristão
web-designer.description:
Shopify e-commerce | Custom layout | Christian articles

Context and objective: The project arose from the client's desire to migrate their Christian articles website, which operated on another platform, to Shopify. The intention was to modernize the homepage and the rest of the store, maintaining the welcoming look and original identity that already pleased customers.

Challenge: The main difficulty was to recreate the old layout, hosted on wbuy, faithfully on the new platform. The client wanted the visual experience to remain practically the same, which required care to adapt the original design using the structure and resources of Shopify.

Solution and execution: I implemented the entire layout on Shopify, making specific adjustments in CSS and HTML to bring the new site as close as possible to the old one. I worked on the colors of the logo in a clean and harmonious way, to convey tranquility and facilitate navigation. At the same time, I preserved elements that the client considered essential for the brand identity.

Result: The result was a well-designed Christian articles store, with an organized visual and reinforced brand presence. I achieved an approximate 95% fidelity level to the previous layout, offering a familiar experience to customers while being more modern and functional.

web-designer.title: 2terços
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout | Christian t-shirts

Context and objective: The project arose from the client's desire to transform success on social media into a more structured online presence. The brand, specializing in Christian t-shirts and faith items, wanted to create an online store to expand sales beyond Instagram and WhatsApp marketing.

Challenge: The store development was smooth, without significant technical challenges. The main focus was on translating the brand's identity into a digital environment with simplicity and clarity.

Solution and execution: I implemented the layout on Shopify, prioritizing a clean and intuitive navigation experience. I worked with a blue and white palette, making blue the predominant color to refer to serenity and faith, while white conveys purity and balance. I structured the product sections as t-shirts, rosaries, and new arrivals, maintaining consistency across all pages.

Result: The result is a modern and clean Christian t-shirt store, where the blue and white provide a pleasant visual that highlights the pieces. The navigability is simple and the brand's faith identity remains strong, helping to convert the social media audience into loyal customers.

web-designer.title: La vienne
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout + banners | Imported perfumes

Context and objective: La Vienne was born from the client's desire to take their imported perfumes beyond social networks, creating an online showcase that reflected the status and care for each fragrance. The goal was to build a sophisticated virtual store aligned with the luxury standard of the product.

Challenge: The project did not present any eminent technical challenges, which allowed focusing efforts on aesthetics and user experience. The priority was to ensure that the brand's visual identity was translated flawlessly into the layout and graphic elements.

Solution and execution: I implemented the entire layout on Shopify, creating collection banners that reinforce the concept of exclusivity. I worked with a palette of golden and black tones to convey refinement and luxury, perfectly combining with the brand's proposal. The elements were distributed cleanly, so that the imported products occupied the prominence of the experience.

Result: The site gained a luxurious yet clean look, enhancing the imported perfumes of the brand. The dark and golden colors reinforce the premium positioning, and the personalized banners create a feeling of exclusivity and elegance in each section.

web-designer.title: Oliver Essence
web-designer.description:
Yampi E-commerce | Custom layout | Fine perfumery with a sophisticated proposal

Context and objective: Oliver Essence emerged with the intention of creating a perfume e-commerce with a premium presence, translating the idea of fine perfumery into a more elegant and reliable digital environment. The idea was to have a direct showcase, with a sober visual language and a total focus on the product, reinforcing quality and credibility from the start.

Challenge: The development was very smooth and did not have any relevant challenges, which allowed us to concentrate energy on visual finishing, organization and consistency. The greatest care was to maintain a sophisticated and clean aesthetic, to match the brand positioning and facilitate navigation.

Solution and execution: I implemented the layout in Yampi working a minimalist identity, with basic colors like black and white and a more straight composition, using less rounded formats to elevate the feeling of sophistication. I structured the home to present the store as a perfumery showcase, highlighting collections and organized navigation by categories.

Result: The result was a modern, clean store aligned with the concept of fine perfumery, where the brand appears clearly and the product takes center stage. The more organized aesthetic reinforces the sophisticated positioning and makes the purchase journey more objective, without visual noise.

web-designer.title: Solore Beachwear
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout | Women's beach fashion

Context and objective: The client already had a presence selling beach fashion in a more informal way and wanted to expand sales to the digital realm through Shopify. The goal was to create an online store that reflected the brand's relaxed and elegant style, with a visual that evoked the coastal climate.

Challenge: The client requested a centered header, which required adaptations to the theme's CSS code to ensure that the centering did not break on different screen sizes. In addition, it was necessary to balance light and strong colors to convey the feeling of sea and beach without losing readability or overloading the page.

Solution and execution: I implemented the layout on Shopify following the client's references and personal taste, adjusting the CSS to center the header harmoniously. I worked on a dynamic palette with shades of sand and sea blue, varying these colors in different sections to give movement and avoid visual monotony. These choices helped align the brand's identity with the beach spirit that was intended to be conveyed.

Result: The result was a modern and well-organized website, with a centered header that gives balance to the navigation. The chosen colors evoke the sea and the beach, creating a pleasant atmosphere that combines with the products. The variation between shades of sand and sea blue brought harmony and dynamism, reflecting the essence of a seaside lifestyle.

web-designer.title: ESSENC
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout + hyper-realistic images | Casual fashion focused on basic t-shirts

Context and objective: The client wanted to modernize the homepage and align the visual with a specific inspiration, maintaining some elements that already worked. There was also a desire to expand the brand's reach by creating a female division that did not previously exist, adding new products to the basic t-shirt portfolio.

Challenge: One of the biggest challenges was dealing with the AI-generated product images, which seemed artificial and misaligned with the brand's proposal. To solve this, it was necessary to recreate hyper-realistic photos using AI techniques (such as Gemini and adjustments with Nano Banana) to achieve lighting and textures consistent with real pieces. It was also necessary to reorganize the website's structure to accommodate the new female category without compromising the visual identity.

Solution and execution: I introduced a new layout both on the homepage and throughout the rest of the site, adapting the structure to maintain the functionalities that the client liked. I recreated the images to make them more natural and refined, adjusting light, shadow, and context, which elevated the visual quality of the products. The new interface was designed to be clean and modern, with a neutral color palette and well-distributed spaces, highlighting each t-shirt. The creation of the female division included new pages, categories, and navigation adjustments to accommodate the extra products harmoniously.

Result: The final visual was clean and modern, in harmony with the brand's basic t-shirts. The hyper-realistic images conveyed more credibility and improved the perception of the products, while the new layout brought freshness and usability. The creation of the female division expanded the catalog and opened up new sales opportunities, consolidating Essenc as a versatile and updated brand.

web-designer.title: Base Forte
web-designer.description:
Shopify Landing Page | Strategic Structure + Liquid Customization | Dietary Supplement

Overview

The Colágeno Forte landing page was developed with a strong focus on direct conversion, highlighting clear benefits, social proof, and structured offers for different consumption cycles. The main objective was to transform a standard product page into a persuasive, organized, and visually trustworthy experience, suitable for paid traffic and targeted campaigns.
