Context and objective

The challenge was to build a landing page within Shopify that would not look like a default product page. It was necessary to use third-party theme sections as a foundation while elevating the strategic level through visual organization, clear information hierarchy, and conversion-driven content blocks. The goal was to structure a narrative that guides the user from benefits to social proof, and from proof to offer.

The challenge

Working within the limitations of a pre-built theme requires technical precision. Some sections needed to be adapted to accommodate new content blocks, improved visual organization, and stronger conversion elements. At the same time, performance and responsiveness had to be preserved, ensuring a seamless experience on both desktop and mobile.

The strategy

The page structure followed a layered persuasion logic:

  • Strong first fold: product highlight, clear promise, and direct CTA.

  • Benefit blocks: sections explaining collagen benefits, hydration, elasticity, vitamins, and minerals supported by visuals.

  • Social proof: reviews and proven results to build credibility.

  • Structured offers: 1, 2, and 3-month plans with progressive financial incentives.

  • Nutritional information and FAQ: objection reduction before the final decision.

What was implemented

Technical customization:

  • Liquid: creation and adaptation of custom sections for strategic content organization.

  • Additional CSS: fine adjustments to layout, spacing, typography, and visual highlights to reinforce hierarchy.

  • Complementary HTML: structuring specific areas such as plan comparison tables, trust badges, and informational blocks.

Conversion structure:

  • Benefit sections with icons: fast and objective reading.

  • Contrasting background blocks: visual emphasis on formula and differentiators.

  • Offer cards: clear comparison between plans with savings incentives.

  • Testimonials and results: authority reinforcement and social validation.

  • Strategic FAQ: anticipation of doubts to reduce checkout friction.

Result

The Colágeno Forte landing page evolved from a simple product page into a structured conversion-focused experience. With a clear narrative, organized content blocks, and tailored technical customizations, the LP delivers credibility, clarity, and direct purchase incentives while maintaining Shopify performance and responsiveness.

web-designer.title: Thouren
web-designer.description:
Shopify Landing Page | Custom Sections with Liquid + CSS | Men’s Grooming Product (USA)

Overview

This landing page was developed for an American company in the men’s grooming segment, focusing on performance, clarity, and high-conversion structure. Although built using the same technical stack as previous projects, the narrative, positioning, and visual approach were entirely adapted to match the U.S. market expectations and consumer behavior.

Context and objective

The goal was to create a product-focused landing page that communicates strength, safety, and performance. The brand needed a bold and masculine visual identity, combined with a clear benefit-driven structure that highlights technology, ergonomic design, waterproof capability, and precision engineering. The LP was built to support paid traffic campaigns and maximize direct response conversions.

The challenge

Even using a third-party Shopify theme as a foundation, the page needed a custom feel rather than a standard product layout. It required strategic restructuring of sections, stronger visual hierarchy, and conversion-focused storytelling. Additionally, the U.S. market demands trust signals, clear specifications, and fast purchase decision flow — all without overwhelming the user.

The strategy

The page was structured following a persuasive product narrative:

  • Hero section with strong value proposition: product image, price anchor, reviews, and direct CTA.

  • Feature grid: quick-scan benefit blocks (waterproof, safe blades, ergonomic grip, quiet performance, portability, battery power).

  • Technology breakdown sections: anti-cut system, ergonomic grip, waterproof functionality, and advanced engineering explained in individual visual blocks.

  • Customer reviews: star rating and testimonials to reinforce credibility.

  • FAQ section: addressing objections before checkout.

What was implemented

Technical customization:

  • Liquid: custom sections created to restructure the product storytelling flow beyond the default Shopify template.

  • CSS refinement: adjustments to spacing, typography contrast, dark-mode sections, and CTA emphasis to align with a bold masculine aesthetic.

  • Additional HTML structure: feature grids, benefit cards, and trust indicators built for better readability and conversion flow.

Conversion-focused structure:

  • Strong CTA repetition: “Add to Cart” strategically positioned throughout the page.

  • Contrast-based layout: black and orange sections to create visual rhythm and highlight key benefits.

  • Authority signals: star ratings, shipping information, and warranty indicators.

  • Performance-oriented messaging: benefit-driven copy aligned with American consumer expectations.

Result

The final landing page delivers a bold, high-impact, and conversion-driven experience tailored to the U.S. market. By combining structured storytelling, strong visual hierarchy, and technical customization within Shopify, the project transformed a standard product layout into a strategic performance-focused sales page optimized for paid acquisition.

web-designer.title: Imperial Sexshop
web-designer.description:
The Imperial SexShop project emerged from the client’s need to modernize the store’s layout, which was struggling with various technical and performance issues. The solution was to create a landing page developed on WordPress using Elementor and Elementor Pro. The primary objective was to maintain visual consistency with the main online store’s identity, ensuring a seamless experience for users arriving via Google Ads campaigns.

In addition to a full redesign, the project placed strong emphasis on performance optimization. With significant improvements in performance and SEO metrics, the page achieved scores between 96 and 100, guaranteeing fast and reliable navigation for users.

The final outcome was a landing page visually aligned with the main store, offering superior performance and a modern, efficient design. This project consolidated my technical expertise in WordPress development, Elementor, performance optimization, and advanced SEO strategies.

web-designer.title: Onli Street
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout | Minimalist streetwear palette

Context and objective: The client wanted to bring their streetwear brand to the digital world, creating an online storefront that translated the brand's attitude and urban style. The goal was to build a store that was direct, focused on the product, and conveyed a modern image without excessive elements.

Challenge: At the client's direction, the color palette should be extremely basic, practically limited to black and white to match the logo. This limited the possibility of working with variations or halftones and required finding a point of emphasis without straying from the identity. The only color outside of this scheme allowed was a specific green on action buttons, used to draw attention to conversions.

Solution and execution: I implemented the entire layout in Shopify, using black and white as a base to enhance the pieces, especially the colorful sneakers. Green was applied to buttons and CTAs to guide the eye without breaking the monochromatic proposal. I maintained a minimalist design, focusing on strong typography and high-quality product images, allowing both colorful and basic items to fit harmoniously within the context of the brand.

Result: The result was a clean and modern streetwear store that emphasizes the products. The color choices make the sneakers and pieces with tonal variations stand out, while the black and white items integrate perfectly into the overall aesthetic. The simplicity and organization of the layout create a fluid and direct navigation experience, reinforcing the brand's personality in the digital environment.

web-designer.title: Rian Store
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout | Streetwear

Context and objective: Rian Store emerged with the proposal to bring a streetwear brand to the digital world in a professional and ready-to-sell manner. The goal was to structure an online store that conveyed the brand's urban style with a clean, direct, and easy-to-navigate visual, valuing the product as the protagonist.

Challenge: The project was very smooth and did not present relevant technical challenges, which allowed us to focus more on organization and visual finishing. With the bases well defined from the beginning, the priority was to guarantee consistency, readability and an objective shopping experience.

Solution and execution: I implemented the layout on Shopify seeking a minimalist identity, aligned with streetwear, with a focus on a clear showcase structure and simple navigation. I worked the visual with a predominance of black and white to keep the store sophisticated and modern, always leaving the focus on the pieces. The construction was done thinking about visual performance and a direct purchase flow.

Result: The result was a store with a standardized and harmonious aesthetic, boosted by the fact that the client already had photos of the clothes with a very consistent background. The combination of this photographic pattern with a black and white layout created a strong, organized and branded showcase, reinforcing the street identity in a clean and professional way.

web-designer.title: Dom Skateboards
web-designer.description:
WBuy E-commerce | Personalized home in a free theme | Skateboards and parts with a premium look

Context and objective: Dom Patinetes was born from the client's need to bring the strength of the physical store to the digital, acting in a less conventional niche and with few competitors really well positioned. The objective was to create a reliable online showcase, with a professional appearance and a focus on conversion, transmitting authority in the segment of skateboards, parts and accessories.

Challenge: Being one of the first experiences in WBuy, adapting to the interfaces and the way to edit the theme took time to understand the flow and “get the hang” of the platform. In addition, the client used the free theme, which limits customizations on the product page, concentrating improvements and resources mainly on the home page.

Solution and execution: I implemented and organized the entire layout of the home within the limits of the free theme, building a strong showcase with an impactful main banner, shortcuts by categories and well-defined sections for new releases and bestsellers. I took advantage of the brand manual and high-quality photos to transform the aesthetics into something premium, working contrast and presence with dark tones and yellow, as well as visual elements that reinforce the urban and sporty universe of the skateboard. I also structured areas of social proof and purchase benefits to increase confidence and facilitate the decision.

Result: The result was a store on WBuy with a premium appearance, even using a free theme and respecting its limitations. The home page became organized, visually strong and with a clear hierarchy, highlighting products, categories and brand differentials. This raised the standard of presentation and left Dom Patinetes ready to compete with more authority in the digital.

web-designer.title: Screw Company
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout + visual identity + banners | Streetwear with a clean aesthetic

Context & Objective: The project arose from the client's desire to launch a streetwear store with a more basic and direct aesthetic, without relying on flashy colors. The proposal was to build a modern and coherent digital presence with the brand's style, maintaining a clean, urban, and personalized look.

Challenge: The logo went through several phases before reaching the final version, which made the vectorization more laborious and required care to preserve proportions and finish. Another challenge was the limitation of photos, since the client had images of the t-shirts without a model, which reduced the visual impact of the products. To solve this without losing fidelity, it was necessary to create alternatives that maintained the original print and seemed natural to the public.

Solution & Execution: In addition to implementing the layout on Shopify, I created the banners and developed the vectorized visual identity in Illustrator, following the client's choices, including the modern serif typography. At his request, I replaced the registered symbol with a “3” to represent the three partners of the brand, bringing a unique and meaningful detail. For the banners, I worked on a black and white language with support from the brand's dark navy blue, and used subtle visual elements such as street elements and torn paper effect. I also used AI to generate realistic models applying the original print, increasing the strength of the product presentation.

Result: The result was a streetwear store with a clean and modern feel, maintaining the urban aesthetic without exaggeration. The visual identity was strong and differentiated, with a symbolic detail that reinforces the brand's story. The banners brought consistency and attitude, valuing the pieces and elevating the professional perception of the project.

web-designer.title: Carioca Concept
web-designer.description:
Yampi E-commerce | Custom layout + CSS adjustments | Brand with a clean and striking identity

Context and objective: The project arose from the client's desire to create a professional online store to consolidate the brand in the digital space. The goal was to build a consistent storefront with a clean visual and a strong identity, ensuring that the experience conveyed trust and valued the products.

Challenge: The development was smooth, without major execution obstacles. The point of attention was the limitations of CSS on the platform, which required punctual adjustments to maintain fidelity to the identity manual and ensure a more refined finish.

Solution and execution: I implemented the layout in Yampi based on the identity manual, following color patterns, visual hierarchy, and brand style. I made modifications in CSS to correct front-end details and maintain consistency between sections and pages. The composition was designed so that navigation was simple, focused on the product and reinforcing the brand.

Result: The result was a clean, well-organized website with a strong identity. The brand's tones appear throughout the store, creating visual unity and presence, while the structure maintains a practical and intuitive shopping experience.

web-designer.title: Marie's Secrets
web-designer.description:
Shopify E-commerce | Custom layout + personalization field | Children's fashion store

Context and objective: The store needed a completely new layout to reflect the delicacy and tenderness of the children's universe. The goal was to create a friendly and gentle shopping experience that valued personalized products and communicated with the brand's color palette.

Challenge: The original palette had several light colors and it was necessary to select the shades that ensured adequate readability and contrast. Another important challenge was to implement a personalization field where the customer could enter their child's name for custom production, something essential for the type of product offered.

Solution and execution: I designed the layout on Shopify, adjusting the base theme with HTML and CSS to achieve a delicate and coherent visual with the segment. I integrated a specific application from the platform to add the personalization field, ensuring that the functionality worked stably. The colors were chosen carefully, maintaining pastel tones that harmonized with the product thumbnails and transmitted the welcoming feeling that the brand intended.

Result: The result was a modern and delicate store, where the light colors and visual elements are in harmony with the product photos. The personalization field made it possible for parents to add their child's name simply and intuitively, adding value to the product and improving the shopping experience.

web-designer.title: 520 Rouparia
web-designer.description:
Tray E-commerce | Institutional layout | Women's fashion with direct storefront

Context and objective: 520 Rouparia was created to quickly and functionally bring the brand online, with a store ready to organize categories and sell without relying solely on social media. The idea was to have a simple storefront, with direct communication of promotions and a light environment to showcase the pieces.

Challenge: Being a project with a more generic structure within Tray, the focus was to work with what the platform offers as standard, without promising something totally exclusive. The greatest care was to maintain visual consistency and organization, so that the store would not have an improvised appearance even using a more standard template.

Solution and execution: I implemented the store using a clean and neutral aesthetic, exploring earthy and light tones to create a sense of elegance and lightness. I structured the home as the main storefront, with a large promotion banner, benefits right below, and shortcuts by category with images, making it easier for the user to reach the products. The new arrivals and favorites sections were organized objectively, maintaining plenty of visual breathing room to enhance the photos.

Result: The result was a functional and well-presented store, with a clear storefront and simple navigation. Even with a more generic layout, the whole set was coherent and had a professional appearance, highlighting promotions, categories and products with a light visual identity aligned with the fashion segment.
